title: Rejecting the suggestion he ran girls; his dislike of leading bands
summary: Howard laughs off the question of women working for him, says he likes responsibility but hates being a bandleader.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: And some crazy things happening in those days. Somebody told me you had some girls working for you on the south side.
Is that true? For what? You had some girls who were working for you. For me? Three or four girls. Is that true?
Look, I wouldn't be able to tell you about me playing music so long if I did that.
Well I mean some people manage to do both, you know. Uh-uh.

No. In those days, no, I wouldn't have to play no music. I'd been a pretty lazy guy by this time. No, I never do nothing like that, no way. No, I didn't care for that. That's when I was just open home, you know, I can't see that either. I like responsibility. Wow. I do. How come you decided to be a musician then? Well that's responsibility, it is. Only I don't want to be no band leader, that's how I hate that.
